description: TypeScript utility to replace bash envsubst/injection pipeline for generating xrpld and clio configuration files from .env or JSON input

userStories.title: Define xrpld defaults schema in TypeScript
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all xrpld default environment variables defined in TypeScript so that config generation uses the same defaults as the bash scripts.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/config-gen/defaults/xrpld.ts with all variables from packages/docker/xrpld/scripts/defaults/common.sh and config/defaults.sh
Include network-specific overrides for MAINNET, TESTNET, DEVNET (from defaults/mainnet.sh, testnet.sh, devnet.sh)
Include size-based LEDGER_RETENTION mapping (DEFAULT=512, SMALL=512, MEDIUM=1024, LARGE=2048, HUGE=4096, FULL=full)

Include computed/conditional sections: NODE_SIZE_SECTION, VALIDATION_QUORUM_SECTION, PEERS_MAX_SECTION, VALIDATION_SEED_SECTION, VALIDATORS_SITE_SECTION, IPS_SECTION, IPS_FIXED_SECTION, REPORTING_SECTION, LEDGER_TX_TABLES_SECTION, NODE_DB_OPTIONS
Include SSL-derived variable computation (build_ssl_derived logic): PORT_RPC_PROTOCOL, PORT_WSS_PROTOCOL, SSL_VERIFY, SSL_LINES
Export typed interface XrpldConfig with all variable names and their types
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define Clio defaults schema in TypeScript
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all Clio default environment variables defined in TypeScript so that config generation uses the same defaults as the bash scripts.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/config-gen/defaults/clio.ts with all variables from packages/docker/clio/scripts/defaults/common.sh
Include SSL-derived variable computation (build_ssl_derived logic): SSL_CERT_FILE, SSL_KEY_FILE
Include all database, ETL, server, logging, cache, prometheus, and API version defaults
Export typed interface ClioConfig with all variable names and their types
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement input parsing for .env and JSON files
userStories.description: As a user, I want to provide configuration via .env files or JSON files so that I can use whichever format is convenient.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/config-gen/parsers/env-parser.ts that reads .env files (KEY=VALUE, supports comments with #, blank lines, quoted values)
Create src/config-gen/parsers/json-parser.ts that reads flat or nested JSON and flattens to key-value pairs matching the expected variable names
Both parsers return a Record<string, string> of variable overrides
Parsing errors throw descriptive error messages with line numbers (for .env) or JSON path (for JSON)
Unit tests cover: basic parsing, comments, quoted values, empty values, malformed input
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement input validation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need input validation that catches configuration errors before generating output, matching the behavior of the existing bash validate.sh scripts.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/config-gen/validation.ts with validators: validatePort, validateBoolean, validateUrl, validateRequired

Implement validateXrpldInputs() that validates all xrpld-specific fields (6 ports, network enum, size enum, booleans: SSL_GENERATE, SSL_GENERATE_OVERWRITE, SSL_CHAIN_ENABLED, PEER_PRIVATE, NODE_DB_ADVISORY_DELETE)
Implement validateClioInputs() that validates all Clio-specific fields (4 ports, booleans: SSL_GENERATE, ALLOW_NO_ETL, SERVER_LOCAL_ADMIN, READ_ONLY, PROMETHEUS_ENABLED)
Validation returns structured errors (field name, value, message) not just strings
Unit tests cover: valid inputs, invalid ports, invalid booleans, missing required fields, unknown network/size warnings
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement template substitution engine
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a template engine that replaces ${VAR} placeholders in template strings with resolved values, matching the behavior of bash envsubst.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/config-gen/template.ts with a substitute(template: string, vars: Record<string, string>): string function
Handles ${VAR} syntax (matches the regex ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$ for valid variable names, same as generate_var_list in envsubst.sh)
Unresolved variables are replaced with empty string (matching envsubst behavior)
Handles multi-line section variables (e.g., NODE_SIZE_SECTION, SSL_LINES that contain newlines)
Cleans up excessive blank lines from empty optional sections (collapses 3+ consecutive blank lines to 2)
Unit tests cover: simple substitution, missing variables, multi-line sections, empty sections cleanup
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement xrpld config generator
userStories.description: As a user, I want to generate a valid xrpld.cfg file from my input variables so I can configure a rippled node.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/config-gen/generators/xrpld.ts that orchestrates: load defaults -> merge overrides -> compute derived vars -> validate -> substitute template -> output
Uses the xrpld.cfg template from packages/docker/xrpld/etc/xrpld.cfg (bundled as a string constant)
Correctly computes all conditional sections (NODE_SIZE_SECTION, NODE_DB_OPTIONS, REPORTING_SECTION, etc.) based on input variables
Correctly resolves network-specific defaults based on NETWORK variable
Correctly resolves size-specific LEDGER_RETENTION based on SIZE variable
Output matches the format produced by the existing bash pipeline for the same inputs
Unit tests cover: default config generation, each network preset, each size preset, SSL enabled/disabled, reporting mode, custom overrides
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement Clio config generator
userStories.description: As a user, I want to generate a valid config.json file from my input variables so I can configure a Clio server.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/config-gen/generators/clio.ts that orchestrates: load defaults -> merge overrides -> compute derived vars -> validate -> substitute template -> output
Uses the config.json template from packages/docker/clio/etc/config.json (bundled as a string constant)
Correctly computes SSL-derived variables (SSL_CERT_FILE, SSL_KEY_FILE)
Output is valid JSON when all variables are resolved
Unit tests cover: default config generation, SSL enabled/disabled, custom database settings, custom ETL source
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement CLI interface
userStories.description: As a user, I want a CLI command to generate config files from the terminal.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/config-gen/cli.ts as the CLI entry point
Command: config-gen <target> where target is xrpld or clio
Flag --env <path> to read from a .env file
Flag --json <path> to read from a JSON file
Flag --output <path> to write output to a file (defaults to stdout)
Flag --validate-only to run validation without generating output
When both --env and --json are provided, JSON values override .env values
Also reads from process.env as lowest-priority fallback
Exits with code 1 on validation errors, printing errors to stderr
Add bin field to packages/utils/package.json pointing to the CLI
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Export programmatic API from packages/utils
userStories.description: As a developer using the utils package, I want to import config generation functions directly.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/config-gen/index.ts that exports: generateXrpldConfig, generateClioConfig, parseEnvFile, parseJsonFile, validateXrpldInputs, validateClioInputs
Add config-gen sub-export to packages/utils/package.json exports map (matching the existing crypto sub-export pattern)
Update src/index.ts to also re-export from config-gen
Each generator function accepts { env?: string, json?: string, overrides?: Record<string, string> } and returns { config: string, warnings: string[] }
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Integration tests with real templates
userStories.description: As a developer, I need integration tests that verify the generated configs match the output of the bash scripts for known inputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Create test fixtures: a set of .env files and JSON files with known inputs for both xrpld and clio
Create expected output files (generated by running the bash scripts with those inputs)
Integration tests compare TypeScript output against expected output
Tests cover: default (no overrides), MAINNET/TESTNET/DEVNET, SIZE=SMALL/FULL, SSL enabled, custom ports
All tests pass via pnpm test
Typecheck passes
